## Rule name
A short descriptive name (e.g. "Peel Chain Detection")

## Detection logic
What on-chain pattern does this rule detect?

## Inputs required
What data does the rule need? (wallet profile, tx stats, trace result)

## Proposed severity
- [ ] LOW
- [ ] MEDIUM
- [ ] HIGH
- [ ] CRITICAL

## Is it deterministic?
This is required — forensic rules must produce identical output for identical input,
with zero LLM dependency.

## Research reference (if any)
Link to FATF typology, academic paper, or FinCEN guidance this rule is based on.
